items.exampleEn: She spoke with authority, so everyone listened.
items.exampleZh: 她說話很有權威，所以大家都聽她的。

items.exampleEn: The guard checked our tickets before admission.
items.exampleZh: 警衛在入場前檢查了我們的票。

items.exampleEn: The car failed its safety inspection.
items.exampleZh: 這輛車沒通過安全檢查。

items.exampleEn: His signature looks like a little cat.
items.exampleZh: 他的簽名看起來像一隻小貓。
下雨天開車要注意安全。

items.exampleEn: Phone theft is common in crowded places.
items.exampleZh: 在擁擠的地方，手機失竊很常見。

items.exampleEn: I bought a postcard of the old bridge.
items.exampleZh: 我買了一張那座舊橋的明信片。

items.exampleEn: The bus service here runs every ten minutes.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的公車服務每十分鐘一班。

items.sentenceEn: The museum is closed for an inspection today.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館今天因為檢查而休館。

items.audioEn: Children under six enter the zoo for free, but they need a ticket from the front desk.
items.audioZh: 六歲以下兒童免費入園，但需要到服務台拿票。
items.questionZh: 六歲以下的孩子入園要怎麼做？
options: Buy a ticket online a few days before.
Get a ticket from the desk without paying.
Pay half price at the front desk.
Enter with no ticket at all.

items.sentenceEn: All the children got home safely.
items.sentenceZh: 所有孩子都平安到家了。

items.sentenceEn: Send me a postcard from your trip!
items.sentenceZh: 旅行時寄張明信片給我！

items.stemEn: The police are looking into the ____ of a car from the parking lot.
items.stemZh: 警方正在調查停車場一輛車失竊的案子。

items.stemEn: Please read the form carefully, and then add your ____ at the bottom.
items.stemZh: 請仔細看過表格，然後在最下面簽名。

items.passageEn: Last month, someone stole my bike from outside the library. I reported the theft to the police, and an officer asked for my signature on a form. The next week, a city worker came to do a safety inspection of the area. The city authorities then put up a warning sign. They also started a new service at the library: free bike locks, so people can park safely. Admission to the library is still free. My aunt, who lives abroad, heard the story and sent me a postcard that said, "Sorry about your bike!"
items.passageZh: 上個月，有人從圖書館外面偷走了我的腳踏車。我向警察報案，一位警員要我在一份表格上簽名。隔週，一位市府人員來做這一帶的安全檢查。接著市府當局立了一個警告標誌，還在圖書館開始一項新服務：免費的腳踏車鎖，讓大家可以安全停車。圖書館仍然免費入場。我住在國外的阿姨聽說了這件事，寄給我一張明信片，上面寫著：「腳踏車的事真遺憾！」

questions.questionZh: 作者報案後，警員要作者做什麼？
市府在圖書館開始了什麼服務？

items.promptZh: 只有經理有權力更改班表。
referenceEn: Only the manager has the authority to change the schedule.
Only the manager has authority to change the schedule.
rubricZh: authority 表示「權力」，例如 have the authority to… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 這家飯店提供二十四小時的客房服務。
referenceEn: This hotel offers twenty-four-hour room service.
This hotel provides room service twenty-four hours a day.
rubricZh: 用 service 表示「服務」（例如 room service）
